import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
fz = repo / 'target/debug/fz'
root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fozzylang-unsafe-ffi-audit-'))
valid = root / 'valid'
(valid / 'src').mkdir(parents=True)
(valid / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_valid"
version="0.1.0"

[[target.bin]]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_valid"
path="src/main.fzy"
')
(valid / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('#[repr(C)]
struct Packet {
    value: i32,
}

ext unsafe c fn host_apply(cb_ctx: *mut u8, cb: fn(i32) -> i32, buf_borrowed: *u8, buf_len: usize) -> *u8;
#[ffi_panic(abort)]
pubext c fn dispatch(packet: Packet, out_owned: *u8, out_len: usize) -> Packet {
    discard host_apply
    discard out_owned
    discard out_len
    return packet
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    unsafe {
        discard host_apply
    }
    let p = alloc(16)
    defer free(p)
    return 0
}
')
unsafe_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'audit', 'unsafe', str(valid), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
assert unsafe_proc.returncode == 0, (unsafe_proc.returncode, unsafe_proc.stdout, unsafe_proc.stderr)
unsafe_payload = json.loads(unsafe_proc.stdout.strip())
assert unsafe_payload['missingContractCount'] == 0, unsafe_payload
assert unsafe_payload['invalidOwnerIdCount'] == 0, unsafe_payload
unsafe_entries = unsafe_payload['entries']
assert unsafe_entries, unsafe_payload
assert any(entry.get('owner_id') for entry in unsafe_entries), unsafe_entries
unsafe_md = pathlib.Path(unsafe_payload['docsMarkdown'])
assert unsafe_md.exists(), unsafe_payload
assert 'Owner ID' in unsafe_md.read_text(), unsafe_md.read_text()
ffi_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'audit', 'ffi', str(valid), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
assert ffi_proc.returncode == 0, (ffi_proc.returncode, ffi_proc.stdout, ffi_proc.stderr)
ffi_payload = json.loads(ffi_proc.stdout.strip())
assert ffi_payload['pointerContractViolationCount'] == 0, ffi_payload
assert ffi_payload['callbackContextAnchorViolationCount'] == 0, ffi_payload
assert ffi_payload['ffiStableTypeViolationCount'] == 0, ffi_payload
assert ffi_payload['asyncImportViolationCount'] == 0, ffi_payload
assert ffi_payload['missingPanicBoundaryCount'] == 0, ffi_payload
assert ffi_payload['report']['schemaVersion'] == 'fozzylang.ffi_report.v2', ffi_payload
ffi_md = pathlib.Path(ffi_payload['markdown'])
assert ffi_md.exists(), ffi_payload
assert 'pointer_contract_ok=true' in ffi_md.read_text(), ffi_md.read_text()
memory_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'audit', 'memory', str(valid), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
assert memory_proc.returncode == 0, (memory_proc.returncode, memory_proc.stdout, memory_proc.stderr)
memory_payload = json.loads(memory_proc.stdout.strip())
assert memory_payload['profile'] == 'strict', memory_payload
assert pathlib.Path(memory_payload['json']).exists(), memory_payload
invalid_unsafe = root / 'invalid_unsafe'
(invalid_unsafe / 'src').mkdir(parents=True)
(invalid_unsafe / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_bad_unsafe"
version="0.1.0"

[[target.bin]]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_bad_unsafe"
path="src/main.fzy"
')
(invalid_unsafe / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('unsafe fn risky(v: i32) -> i32 {
    return v
}

fn main() -> i32 {
    return risky(7)
}
')
bad_unsafe_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'audit', 'unsafe', str(invalid_unsafe), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
assert bad_unsafe_proc.returncode != 0, (bad_unsafe_proc.returncode, bad_unsafe_proc.stdout, bad_unsafe_proc.stderr)
assert 'strict unsafe audit failed' in (bad_unsafe_proc.stderr + bad_unsafe_proc.stdout), (bad_unsafe_proc.stdout, bad_unsafe_proc.stderr)
invalid_ffi = root / 'invalid_ffi'
(invalid_ffi / 'src').mkdir(parents=True)
(invalid_ffi / 'fozzy.toml').write_text('[package]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_bad_ffi"
version="0.1.0"

[[target.bin]]
name="unsafe_ffi_audit_bad_ffi"
path="src/main.fzy"
')
(invalid_ffi / 'src/main.fzy').write_text('ext unsafe c fn host_touch(buf: *u8, len: usize) -> i32;
fn main() -> i32 {
    discard host_touch
    return 0
}
')
bad_ffi_proc = subprocess.run([str(fz), 'audit', 'ffi', str(invalid_ffi), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
assert bad_ffi_proc.returncode != 0, (bad_ffi_proc.returncode, bad_ffi_proc.stdout, bad_ffi_proc.stderr)
assert 'strict safety artifact generation failed' in (bad_ffi_proc.stderr + bad_ffi_proc.stdout) or 'pointer parameters require ownership suffix' in (bad_ffi_proc.stderr + bad_ffi_proc.stdout), (bad_ffi_proc.stdout, bad_ffi_proc.stderr)
print('compiler-unsafe-ffi-audit-hardening-ok')
